# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-03 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- Lamar Jackson (thumb) is expected to be placed on injured reserve this week; coach Jesse Minter said the team will know more on surgery timing within the next couple of days. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2117719218695324017)
- Backup QB Tyler Huntley (turf toe) is also an IR candidate — the Ravens' top two quarterbacks could both land on IR together. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2117719145462608286)
- Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano is confirmed as Thursday night's starter at Jacksonville, becoming the second UDFA QB this season to start for Baltimore. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2117717580781858902)
- Ravens signed QB Kedon Slovis off the Packers' practice squad and added Austin Reed to their own practice squad for QB depth; they also worked out free agent Adrian Martinez. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2117630493026066853)
- Kicker Tyler Loop (groin) is also out, with Jake Moody stepping into the kicking role. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/tyler-loop-injury-moves-jake-moody-into-kicker-role-week-9-jacksonville-jaguars-vega-ioane-hopes-to-return)
